templates.name: From viral RNA copying to sequencing evidence
templates.desc: Trace conceptual +RNA copying and a hypothetical interruption, then interpret illustrative RNA-seq reads on a genome map. Detection alone does not establish ongoing replication or infectious virus.

templates.name: The insertion signature of NSP15
templates.desc: Follow the rare green reporter lineage, understand why limiting dilution helps, then read the insertion-class evidence and assay limits in Bianco et al.’s August 2026 preprint.
